title: Austin Meldon
html_source:
Austin Meldon was born in 1844 in Milltown, county Dublin. He studied medicine at the Catholic University (now University College Dublin) where he had a brilliant career winning gold medals in Midwifery and Diseases of Women and Children, Surgery and the Practice of Medicine, as well as first prizes in the same subjects.
